abilities.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
_curatorNotes: N3 has two hitmarks (15, 29); swap reflects the last hitmark per recipe convention.
Charge attack lands two hits at gcsim chargeHitmarks [19, 27]; chargeFrames reflects the last (27) for D/J cancels and the explicit 50 override for N/E/Q/swap=48.

plungeFrames sourced from gcsim's lowPlungeFramesAL — alhaitham's only standard-rotation plunge variant, accessible only after a Hold E in gcsim (post-hold-skill predicate). Airborne (Xianyun) low/high plunge variants exist (lowPlungeFramesXY, highPlungeFramesXY) but require external launch; not represented per recipe.

Mirror-gated infusion: while Alhaitham possesses ≥1 Chisel-Light Mirror, Normal/Charged/Plunge attacks are converted to Dendro DMG. Schema's `infusion` field on a normal ability is unconditional; the closest existing condition (`state: inStance`) doesn't fit because there is no stance — N/C/P frames are unchanged. Reviewer to wire conditional infusion when the schema supports a mirror-count or holds-mirror condition.

Projection Attack proc: while ≥1 mirror is active, each N/C/P hit triggers an AoE Dendro Projection Attack scaling on talent and EM. Per-hit count = current mirror count (1/2/3); 1.6s ICD between procs (gcsim projectionICDKey = 96f). Snapshot timings per mirror count: [20, 22, 26]f. Multi-hit hitmark slices in gcsim — mirror1HitmarkLeft/Right, mirror2HitmarksLeft/Right, mirror3Hitmarks. Effect not authored — needs reviewer pass once schema supports mirror-state-conditional damage effects.
A1 (Four-Causal Correction) extra mirror-gen on C/P hit, 12s ICD — flagged on the passive.

abilities.description:
Rushes forward, dealing Dendro DMG to nearby opponents when the rush ends, causing a Chisel-Light Mirror to form.
Holding this skill will cause it to behave differently.

Hold
Enters Aiming Mode to adjust the direction of Alhaitham's rush attack.

Chisel-Light Mirror
When this skill is unleashed, Alhaitham will generate 1 Chisel-Light Mirror. If there are no Mirrors at this time, he will generate 1 additional Mirror. Chisel-Light Mirrors will have the following properties:
·When he possesses Chisel-Light Mirrors, Alhaitham's Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks will be converted to Dendro DMG. This cannot be overridden.
·When attacks of the aforementioned kind hit opponents, the Chisel-Light Mirrors will unleash a Projection Attack that deals AoE Dendro DMG based on the number of Mirrors on the field.
·A total of 3 Chisel-Light Mirrors can exist at once.
·The Chisel-Light Mirrors will disappear one after the other over time, and will all disappear when Alhaitham leaves the field.
_curatorNotes: Behavior changed from generator stub `stance` to `instant`. Mirrors do not replace N/C/P frames; the schema's `stance` semantic is N-replacement, not 'caster carries a state'. Mirror state is a self-status that gates infusion + Projection Attack procs (see normal ability notes).

Mirror economy (gcsim, source: skill.go skillMirrorGain / mirrorLoss): on cast, gain 1 mirror; if currently 0 mirrors, gain 2 instead. Cap = 3. Each mirror has its own ~3.88s timer (mirrorInterval = 233f, ticks one mirror down at a time, re-queues while count > 0). All mirrors lost on swap-off (alhaitham-exit subscriber). Schema cannot encode the per-mirror lifetime queue or the 'gain 2 if 0' rule — flagged for reviewer.
Tap E mirror-gain delay = 15f from cast (matches cooldownStartDelay). Hold E mirror-gain delay = 23f. Hitmarks: tap = 19, hold = 28.

Particle generation: Dendro particle on first Projection Attack hit per cast (1.5s ICD on particleICDKey). Not authored as an explicit effect — particle generation is not currently modeled in character JSONs.
C1 (Intuition) reduces this skill's CD by 1.2s per Projection Attack hit, 1s ICD. Flagged on C1.

Per-character pattern note: alhaitham was flagged 'most complex Tier B case' in recipe-tier-b.md. Tap/Hold E authored as variants per the note's guidance; mirror-count gating intentionally not authored as conditions/effects — schema cannot represent stack-keyed buffs and per-mirror lifetimes. All mirror-dependent mechanics flagged here and on consuming abilities.

abilities.name: Particular Field: Fetters of Phenomena
abilities.description:
Creates a Particular Binding Field and deals multiple instances of AoE Dendro DMG.
If Chisel-Light Mirrors exist when this ability is unleashed, all such Mirrors will be consumed and increase the number of DMG instances dealt.
2s after this ability is unleashed, if 0/1/2/3 Mirrors were consumed, Alhaitham will generate 3/2/1/0 new Mirrors in turn.
_curatorNotes: Burst hit count is gated on mirror count at cast time: 4 + 2 * mirrorCount damage instances (4 / 6 / 8 / 10 hits for 0 / 1 / 2 / 3 mirrors). First instance lands at frame 94 (burstHitmark), each subsequent instance at +21 frames; snapshot at frame 67. Schema cannot represent variable-count damage instances; effect not authored.

Burst consumes all current mirrors immediately on cast, then queues a regeneration of (3 - consumed) new mirrors at frame 184 (so 0/1/2/3 consumed → 3/2/1/0 new). C6 forces 3 fresh mirrors regardless of consumed.

C4 (Elucidation) grants stacking team EM and self Dendro DMG bonus per mirror consumed/generated (15s, fixed duration, refresh on next burst). Existing skeletons in C4 use single-stack values (30 EM team, 10% Dendro self) — they assume max-mirror baseline; reviewer to encode the per-mirror-count gating.
energyCost = 70 (data_gen.textproto burst_energy_cost: 70).
ConsumeEnergy(6) on cast — gcsim convention; not relevant to JSON encoding.

passives.name: Four-Causal Correction
passives.description: When Alhaitham's Charged or Plunging Attacks hit opponents, they will generate 1 Chisel-Light Mirror. This effect can be triggered once every 12s.
_curatorNotes: Mirror-gen passive — affects the skill's mirror economy, not a buff per se. Trigger: onHit with abilityType in (charged, plunge) and Target = enemy. ICD: 12s (a1IcdKey = 720 frames). Effect not authored — mirror state isn't a buff in the current schema.

passives.name: Mysteries Laid Bare
passives.description:
Each point of Alhaitham's Elemental Mastery will increase the DMG dealt by Projection Attacks and Particular Field: Fetters of Phenomena by 0.1%.
The DMG of both aforementioned abilities can be increased by a maximum of 100% this way.
_curatorNotes: Scaling buff — value depends on caster's EM (0.1% DMG per point of EM, capped at +100% DMG). The buff applies only to Projection Attacks and Burst damage (gcsim asc.go a4: matches AttackTagElementalBurst OR ICDGroupAlhaithamProjectionAttack). Per recipe scaling-buff rule, `value` field deleted; reviewer to wire as scaling expression with ability-target gating. Generator-inherited stat=em is wrong (this is a DMG bonus, not an EM buff) — reviewer to retype as `allDmgBonus` or add a per-ability-DMG stat.

Inherited trigger: `manual` — likely `passive` (always-on, no event). Conditioned on (self) attacks where AttackTag = ElementalBurst OR ICDGroup = AlhaithamProjectionAttack. Target scope: self (DMG bonus on outgoing damage, gated by ability source).

↻ 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). passive: Mysteries Laid Bare — effects[0] (buff, stat `em`, no value) RE-TRIGGERED. gcsim: `~/Code/gcsim/internal/characters/alhaitham/asc.go:36-57` — a permanent `AddAttackMod` (no event) that returns `DmgP = 0.001 × EM`, clamped at 1.0, only for `AttackTagElementalBurst` or `ICDGroupAlhaithamProjectionAttack` (asc.go:44-48). that the same bonus also covers Projection Attacks (gcsim `ICDGroupAlhaithamProjectionAttack`), which are unauthored, so `burstDmgBonus` deliberately carries only half the kit's scope; and that the generator's `stat: "em"` was the artifact (it read "Elemental Mastery" as the buffed stat rather than the scaling source). ⚠️ `ratio` is the PER-POINT percentage, matching Kazuha A4 (`ratio: 0.04`) and Kazuha C6 (`ratio: 0.2`) — ⛔ not `10`. `cap: 100` is in `burstDmgBonus` units (percentage points), i.e. the kit's "+100% maximum". Drop the authored `durationType: "fixed"` — there is no duration on a `passive`.

constellations.name: Intuition
constellations.description: When a Projection Attack hits an opponent, Universality: An Elaboration on Form's CD is decreased by 1.2s. This effect can be triggered once every 1s.
_curatorNotes: Skill cooldown reduction tied to Projection Attack hits — gcsim cons.go c1: ReduceActionCooldown(ActionSkill, 72f) per trigger, 1s ICD (c1IcdKey = 60f). Not authored as a cooldownModifier (modifier shape is static; this is a runtime cdReduce on hit). Effect not yet authored — reviewer pass.

constellations.name: Debate
constellations.description: When Alhaitham generates a Chisel-Light Mirror, his Elemental Mastery will be increased by 50 for 8 seconds, max 4 stacks. Each stack's duration is counted independently. This effect can be triggered even when the maximum number of Chisel-Light Mirrors has been reached.
_curatorNotes: Inherited trigger: `manual` — likely a custom 'on mirror generated' hook with no current schema equivalent. The current Trigger union has no 'on mirror generated' variant; reviewer to extend or use `onCast` { ability: 'skill' } as proxy (imprecise: misses A1 mirror gen, burst regeneration, and the C2 'overflow still triggers' clause). Stack model added with maxStacks=4, durationModel=separate to match the description.

↻ 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). C2: Debate — effects[0] (buff, stat `em`, value 50) RE-TRIGGERED. gcsim: `cons.go:34-47` — `c2(generated)` adds one 480f (8s) EM+50 StatMod per Mirror generated, called from `skill.go:147` inside `mirrorGain()`, which is itself reached from three places: the skill cast (`skill.go:65` tap, `skill.go:95` hold — a task at 15f/23f), the A1 callback (`asc.go:29`, 720f ICD on a Charged or Plunging hit), and the burst's regeneration task (`burst.go:62`, at 184f). the third source — the Burst regenerates `3 − consumed` Mirrors at frame 184 (3 at C6) and each one grants a stack — deliberately NOT authored, because at C2–C5 the count depends on the Mirrors the Burst consumed, which the parser does not track; and that `BuffEffect.stacks` has no consumer today and is carried as description only. ⚠️ The skill-cast effect fires at the cast while gcsim's Mirror lands 15f (tap) / 23f (hold) later — a quarter-second early. The two effects share `stat: "em"` but sit in different pools (a cast pool vs the hit pass), so the cast pool's stat dedupe cannot collide them. The A1 effect's `procCooldown: 12` is the Mirror-generation ICD, not an effect ICD, and it is correct only because A1 generates exactly one Mirror per fire. A buff on `onHit` must NOT carry `armedFor` (lint B.13b).
constellations.caveat: One Elemental Mastery stack is shown per trigger; in game each Chisel-Light Mirror generated grants its own, and up to four run at once.

constellations.name: Elucidation
constellations.description:
When Particular Field: Fetters of Phenomena is unleashed, the following effects will become active based on the number of Chisel-Light Mirrors consumed and created this time around:
·Each Mirror consumed will increase the Elemental Mastery of all other nearby party members by 30 for 15s.
·Each Mirror generated will grant Alhaitham a 10% Dendro DMG Bonus for 15s.

The pre-existing duration of the aforementioned effects will be cleared if you use Particular Field: Fetters of Phenomena again while they are in effect.
_curatorNotes: Inherited trigger: `manual` — likely `onCast` with `ability: 'burst'`. Both effects are stacking-by-mirror: team EM = 30 * mirrorsConsumed; self Dendro DMG = 10% * mirrorsGenerated. Existing skeletons treat as single-stack (30 EM, 10% Dendro). Schema can't gate by mirror count; reviewer to extend with a `stacks` field keyed off mirror state (consumed vs generated are distinct counts). Generator changed target from 'team' to 'teamExcludingSelf' — verified against gcsim (cons.go c4Loss skips i == c.Index()). durationType set to 'refresh' per description ('pre-existing duration ... will be cleared').
Mirror-gen effect target should clarify 'nearby party members' — assuming team-radius gating handled by runtime, not schema.

↻ 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). C4: Elucidation — effects[0] (buff, stat `em`, value 30, target `teamExcludingSelf`) RE-TRIGGERED. gcsim: `cons.go:58-77` — `c4Loss(consumed)` runs at the burst cast (`burst.go:55`), returns early when `consumed <= 0`, and adds `EM = 30 × consumed` for 900f to every party member except Alhaitham (`cons.go:64-66` skips `i == c.Index()`). that the value is `30 × Mirrors consumed` and that the bar is authored at one Mirror; and that `teamExcludingSelf` is verified against gcsim's index skip, not inferred from "all other nearby party members". ⚠️ Fires on every burst, where gcsim returns early at `consumed == 0` — an over-claim on a burst cast with no Mirrors up, which is unreachable by the parser (no Mirror state). Different `stat` from effects[1], so no dedupe collision inside the burst's cast pool.

↻ 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). C4: Elucidation — effects[1] (buff, stat `dendroDmgBonus`, value 10, target `self`) RE-TRIGGERED. gcsim: `cons.go:79-92` — `c4Gain(generated)` adds `DendroP = 0.1 × generated` for 900f to Alhaitham, called from the burst's queued task at frame 184 (`burst.go:60-67`), which also early-returns if he is no longer the active character. that the value is `10 × Mirrors generated` (`3 − consumed`, forced to 3 at C6), that it actually lands 184f ≈ 3.07s after the cast, and that gcsim drops it entirely if Alhaitham has swapped out by then. ⚠️ The bar starts at the cast and the game's starts ~3.07s later, so the window is 3s early at both ends. Fires on every burst where in game `generated` can be 0 (bursting at 3 Mirrors below C6).
constellations.caveat: Both bars show one Mirror's worth — the Elemental Mastery scales with the Mirrors the Burst consumed and the Dendro DMG Bonus with the Mirrors it created, up to three each.

constellations.name: Structuration
constellations.description:
Alhaitham gains the following effects:
· 2 seconds after Particular Field: Fetters of Phenomena is unleashed, he will generate 3 Chisel-Light Mirrors regardless of the number of mirrors consumed.
· If Alhaitham generates Chisel-Light Mirrors when their numbers have already maxed out, his CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG will increase by 10% and 70% respectively for 6s. If this effect is triggered again during its initial duration, the duration remaining will be increased by 6s.
_curatorNotes: Generator stub had critDmg value=10 — corrected to 70 per description and gcsim cons.go c6 (m[CD] = 0.7).

Inherited trigger: `manual` — likely 'on mirror overflow' (gcsim: triggered when mirrorGain pushes mirrorCount > 3, applies per overflow stack). No schema equivalent; reviewer to extend. Approximation via `onCast` { ability: 'skill' } would miss the overflow gating entirely (only fires when at-cap and gaining more) — reviewer to handle.

Description says 'duration remaining will be increased by 6s' on re-trigger; gcsim implements via ExtendStatus(c6key, 360). durationType set to 'refresh' as the closest approximation; the actual semantic is additive-extend, which the schema doesn't model.
C6 also forces the post-burst regeneration to spawn 3 fresh mirrors regardless of consumed count — flagged on the burst.

↻ 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). C6: Structuration — effects[0] (buff, stat `critRate`, value 10) RE-TRIGGERED. gcsim: `cons.go:103-119` — `c6(generated)` adds CR +0.1 / CD +0.7 for 360f, called from `skill.go:151-153` ONLY on overflow (`if c.mirrorCount > 3 { if Cons >= 6 { c.c6(c.mirrorCount - 3) } }`), i.e. when a generation happens while already at the 3-Mirror cap. The Burst can never reach it: it consumes all Mirrors first, then regenerates at most 3 (`burst.go:48-53`, `burst.go:62`), so `mirrorCount` never exceeds 3. that the trigger is Mirror OVERFLOW (generating at the 3-Mirror cap), that the Burst cannot cause it at any constellation, and that the re-trigger semantic is gcsim's `ExtendStatus(c6key, 360)` — additive extension, which `durationType: "refresh"` approximates. ⚠️ This mints a `mirrors` assertion key that nothing else in Alhaitham's data reads — C2 and C4 deliberately do not gate on it — so the model is coherent only for C6. Invisible by default in the planner; in the Team Builder it surfaces as a `stacks:mirrors` conditional capability, which is strictly more than `manual` gave. ⏭ If Nate does not want a new asserted key, the fallback is RETIRE: an ungated `onCast {ability:'skill'}` would print +10% CRIT Rate / +70% CRIT DMG on the first E of every rotation, where 0 Mirrors → gain 2 → no overflow, which is a flat over-claim. The two effects share `stat: "critRate"` but sit in different pools.

↻ 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). C6: Structuration — effects[1] (buff, stat `critDmg`, value 70) RE-TRIGGERED. gcsim: `cons.go:106` — `m[attributes.CD] = 0.7`, same `c6()` body and same overflow gate as effects[0]. that the generator stub's `value: 10` was corrected to 70 against both the description and gcsim `cons.go:106` — that correction is already recorded and must survive. ⚠️ Same as effects[0]. Four effects for one constellation is the cost of the two stats × two sources; trimming to the skill-cast pair alone is acceptable and loses only the Charged/Plunging path.
